therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Patients with severe heart failure undergoing left ventricular assist device (LVAD) placement
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Safety of cell delivery (total adverse events at 24 months); Improvement in myocardial viability by PET/CT scan (LAD segments at 10 weeks); Combined endpoints of death (24 months)

results.effect_size: 12/16 stem cell vs 2/9 placebo patients completed LVAD turn-down without meeting stopping rules; 2 vs 3 deaths at 24 months
results.target_engagement_evidence: PET/CT viability segments: anterior wall base 14 (stem cell) vs 4 (placebo) safe segments; anterior wall mid 14 vs 4; anterior lateral wall base 15 vs 4; anterior lateral wall mid 15 vs 4
biomarker_changes: Change in LVEDD from baseline to 10 weeks: -0.49 cm (stem cell) vs -0.57 cm (placebo)
Change in LVESD from baseline to 10 weeks: -0.73 cm (stem cell) vs -0.62 cm (placebo)
PET/CT viability: majority of LAD segments remained viable or improved in stem cell group
subgroup_findings: Anterior wall base segment: 14 safe segments (stem cell) vs 4 (placebo)
Anterior wall mid segment: 14 safe segments (stem cell) vs 4 (placebo)
Anterior lateral wall base segment: 15 safe segments (stem cell) vs 4 (placebo)
Anterior lateral wall mid segment: 15 safe segments (stem cell) vs 4 (placebo)
12/16 stem cell patients vs 2/9 placebo patients completed LVAD turn-down without meeting stopping rules
safety_signals: 1 adverse event in stem cell group vs 0 in placebo at 24 months (primary safety endpoint)
Increased bleeding higher in stem cell group (7/16 vs 1/9)
Cerebrovascular accident in 2/16 stem cell patients
Ventricular arrhythmias in 3/16 stem cell vs 3/9 placebo
Atrial arrhythmias in 2/16 stem cell vs 1/9 placebo
Histological assessment: data collection insufficient for analysis

dose_info.dose: 20 x 10^6 cells / 400 microliters per injection, 10 injections (total 200 x 10^6 cells)
dose_info.schedule: single intramyocardial delivery at time of LVAD placement

context.indication: Severe heart failure requiring LVAD placement
context.duration: 24 months follow-up; primary viability endpoint at 10 weeks
context.investigator_commentary: Histological assessment: data collection was insufficient for data analysis. Samples were collected but no histological analysis performed.
